# YourContent

> A local app that makes pictures, clips and music on your own GPU (through ComfyUI), styles them into posts
> with your brand kits, grades photos, cuts reels, and keeps a content calendar. AI agents drive it over MCP
> (Streamable HTTP at /mcp) or a JSON HTTP API. It never posts to social networks and labels every file with
> its model licences.

Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 (free for individuals and companies under 100 people and US$1M revenue).

## Docs

- [Driving YourContent from an AI agent](docs/AGENTS.md): connect, credentials, the job flow, licences, house rules
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md): every route with its request and response
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi.json): the same, machine-readable
- [Google workspace](docs/GOOGLE.md): Drive folder and Content Plan Sheet, drive.file access, setting up an OAuth client
- [Architecture](MAP.md): modules, data folders, flows
